summary: Northside Repair Workshop takes place at Elm Community Room on 2026-11-07, from 10:00 to 13:00. There are 20 places; advance booking is required. Assessment is free. Parts cost extra and require your prior approval. Volunteers will attempt repairs, but success isn't guaranteed. The entrance is step-free; the accessible toilet is unavailable.
